overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that raw_claims contains claims referencing all selected tickers including AAPL, but _keep_after_reopen filters claims based on the proposal which only contains tickers with actual position-sizing output entries, so AAPL claims are excluded before verification even begins.
why_it_breaks: The _claims_for function builds claims from sized.output which only contains entries for tickers that have position-sizing results (e.g., MSFT). When AAPL is selected but has no sizing output entry, the proposal contains no AAPL claim. Then _keep_after_reopen filters raw_claims against this proposal, removing any AAPL-related claims before they reach the citation verifier. The verifier then only sees MSFT claims and approves the single claim that exists, even though it incorrectly cites AAPL position-sizing output that doesn't contain an AAPL entry.
